answer:
The Walt Disney World theme park that experienced the **largest year‑over‑year jump in attendance from 2022 to 2023 was **EPCOT**.

| Park | 2022 Attendance | 2023 Attendance | Growth (number) | Growth (percent) |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|-----------------|------------------|
| **EPCOT** | ~10,000,000 | ~11,980,000 | **+1,980,000** | **+19.8 %** |
| Magic Kingdom | 17,133,000 | 17,720,000 | +587,000 | +3.4 % |
| Hollywood Studios | 10,900,000 | 10,300,000 | –600,000 | –5.5 % |
| Animal Kingdom | 9,027,000 | 8,770,000 | –257,000 | –2.9 % |

Thus, EPCOT saw the greatest increase in visitor numbers—nearly a 20% jump—making it the park with the largest growth in 2023 relative to 2022.
